verdict.rationale: A probe found a live OpenAPI document at buildwithfern.com/openapi.json, which suggests Fern exposes a machine-readable public API. Fern's own programmatic surfaces are the CLI (initialize, validate, publish docs and SDKs) and a private org MCP server that reads sites, deployments and reader activity. The SDK and CLI generators produce clients for customers' APIs, not for driving Fern, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of Fern's own REST API (endpoints, authentication, scope of operations), confirmation of what the openapi.json covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Fern via an API.
